name: datepicker
title: Datepicker
description: Date, date-time and time pickers with ranges, multiple dates and disabled days, themed to match velle-css.

attributes.name: data-datepicker
attributes.description: Turns the input into a picker. The submitted value is ISO formatted (Y-m-d, or Y-m-d H:i); the visible value uses the display format.

attributes.name: data-datepicker-type
attributes.description: "datetime" adds a time picker; "time" shows only a time picker. Leave it out for dates.

attributes.name: data-datepicker-show-months
attributes.description: How many months to show side by side. Defaults to 1.

attributes.name: data-datepicker-disable
attributes.description: JSON array of dates that cannot be picked, e.g. ["2028-01-10","2028-01-11"].

attributes.name: data-datepicker-date-format
attributes.description: Display format for dates (flatpickr tokens). Defaults to "F d, Y".

attributes.name: data-datepicker-datetime-format
attributes.description: Display format for date-times. Defaults to "F d, Y H:i".

notes: The theme overrides flatpickr's own stylesheet, so load flatpickr.min.css before datepicker.css.
For simple cases, a native <input type="date" class="input"> needs no library at all.
flatpickr hides the original input and shows a copy with the same classes but not its inline styles. Size the field through a wrapper or a class, not a style attribute.
